title: Live legacy quiesce run against the real system
description:
Objective: actually quiesce the legacy system, with evidence, under explicit human authority. This is the work task-4e1fe696 is named for and did not do.

WHY THIS TASK EXISTS. task-4e1fe696 "Legacy quiesce drill" is DONE. Its DONE means far less than its title, and nothing on the board currently says so. qa-f6ca780e approved it AT HARNESS SCOPE ONLY and posted the caveat to #governors at 2026-08-15T19:43:38Z, verified independently rather than taken from the worker's disclosure:

  "What landed is a drill HARNESS against a sandbox fixture tree under the OS temp dir. No real daemon, IDE, launcher, watcher, scheduled start, process, handle or access path was stopped, denied, signalled or killed. Zero taskkill/process.kill/child_process/execSync/spawn/net/http/fetch anywhere in tests/migration/cutover/**, no absolute path outside tmpdir, every byte under mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(),"moe-cutover-")). The only 'kill' matches are comments saying it does not kill anything."

The harness is real, useful work and is not in question. What is missing is the run it was built to perform.

THE DANGER THIS TASK CLOSES. task-09008b4c (GA activation record) requires "a SUCCESSFUL Legacy quiesce drill" plus its own GO_ACTIVATE. A readiness sweep that resolves that clause by task id reads task-4e1fe696 = DONE and concludes the drill ran. I ran exactly that scan on 2026-08-15 and it reported task-09008b4c as having NO unmet dependencies. It has two. An id-resolution scan structurally cannot see a prose human-authority gate, and the emptier the id match, the greener the false result. Without this task on the board there is nothing a scan CAN see that says the quiesce has not happened.

WHY IT IS BLOCKED RATHER THAN CLAIMABLE — four gates, three measured unmet today:
1. explicit human GO_QUIESCE — NOT GIVEN. I searched every channel in .moe/messages: five messages mention GO_QUIESCE, all sender=system, zero human-authored. QA searched independently and found the same.
2. task-22cfca91 Portability shadow gate — PLANNING, not DONE, and in a different epic.
3. task-0c89476b Disaster restore proof — BLOCKED.
4. Deterministic legacy importer — resolve by title before planning; not separately measured here.

SCOPE WHEN UNBLOCKED: perform the quiesce against the real system using the landed harness, and record what was actually stopped — process, handle, watcher, scheduled start and access path — as evidence, not as assertion. NOT IN SCOPE: rebuilding or re-scoping the harness (task-4e1fe696 owns it and it is DONE), the GA activation record itself, or granting any authority this task is waiting on.

Verification: to be defined at planning time against the real hosts, and it must not be a sandbox run. A green pnpm test:migration is NOT evidence the legacy system was quiesced.
definitionOfDone: The quiesce is performed against the REAL system, not a fixture tree: the evidence names each actual process, handle, watcher, scheduled start and access path that was stopped or denied, with the observation that proved each one stopped.

A human has given GO_QUIESCE in writing, recorded on this board with the principal and the moment, before any stop action is taken - never inferred from a task status, an instruction to avoid blocking, or a scope-narrowing decision.
Any path that cannot be quiesced is reported as an explicit refusal with its exact stable reason code and the layer that refused, never omitted from the evidence and never reported as success.
The evidence distinguishes a live run from a harness run on its face, so no future reader or automated sweep can mistake one for the other - this task exists because that distinction was lost once.
task-09008b4c (GA activation record) can cite THIS task's live evidence rather than task-4e1fe696's harness status as its quiesce dependency.
taskRails: Do not run any stop action before a human GO_QUIESCE is recorded on this board. An instruction to avoid blocking, to plan production-way, or to keep the fleet busy is NOT a GO_QUIESCE - that exact conflation is why this task exists.
A green pnpm test:migration proves the harness works. It is not evidence the legacy system was quiesced, and it may not be presented as such in any completion report.
Do not rebuild, re-scope or re-approve the harness. task-4e1fe696 owns it, it is DONE, and it was approved at harness scope deliberately. Compose it; do not duplicate it.
Report what was actually stopped, observed one by one. An assertion that a class of thing was stopped, without a per-item observation, is the proof-of-shapes failure Clause 2 forbids.
Re-measure all four gates before planning - GO_QUIESCE, task-22cfca91, task-0c89476b and the deterministic legacy importer. This reason is a snapshot and this board moves fast.
reopenReason:
BLOCKED on creation by governor-18a42000, on the human's instruction to decide and act. Created in BACKLOG only because create_task cannot set BLOCKED directly; this is its intended resting state, and it must not be promoted until all four gates below are met.

FOUR GATES, three measured unmet on 2026-08-15:

1. EXPLICIT HUMAN GO_QUIESCE — NOT GIVEN. I searched every channel under .moe/messages: five messages mention GO_QUIESCE, ALL sender=system, ZERO human-authored. qa-f6ca780e searched independently and reported the identical result. This gate cannot be satisfied by any agent, by any task reaching DONE, or by any instruction to keep the fleet busy.
2. task-22cfca91 Portability shadow gate = PLANNING, not DONE, and in a different epic.
3. task-0c89476b Disaster restore proof = BLOCKED.
4. Deterministic legacy importer — resolve by title and measure before planning.

WHY THIS TASK IS BLOCKED RATHER THAN ABSENT. task-4e1fe696 "Legacy quiesce drill" is DONE, and its DONE overstates what happened: qa-f6ca780e approved it at HARNESS SCOPE ONLY, having verified independently that zero taskkill/process.kill/child_process/spawn/net/http calls exist anywhere under tests/migration/cutover/**, and that every byte lives under mkdtempSync in the OS temp dir. Nothing real was stopped.

That left the board asserting something untrue by omission: a reader or an automated sweep sees "Legacy quiesce drill: DONE" and concludes the legacy system was quiesced. I proved that failure concretely — my own id-resolution readiness scan reported task-09008b4c (GA activation record) as having NO unmet dependencies, because its quiesce clause resolves to task-4e1fe696 = DONE and its GO_ACTIVATE clause is prose that no id scan can see. Had I promoted on that output, the GA cutover record would have become claimable with neither human gate given.

This BLOCKED task is the fix for that blind spot. It is the thing a scan CAN see. It says, in a field a machine reads, that the live quiesce has not happened.

DO NOT PROMOTE UNTIL: a human records GO_QUIESCE in writing on this board with principal and timestamp, AND task-22cfca91 and task-0c89476b are DONE, AND the deterministic legacy importer is measured present. Re-measure all four yourself — this reason is a snapshot and this board moves fast.

DOWNSTREAM: task-09008b4c should cite THIS task's live evidence as its quiesce dependency, not task-4e1fe696's harness status. Its own second gate, GO_ACTIVATE, is likewise unissued, so it sits two human authority gates deep with neither given.
